title: Asymptotic stability of heteroclinic cycles of type Y
summary: We investigate stability of a new class of heteroclinic cycles that we call heteroclinic cycles of type Y. The cycles can be regarded as a generalisation of heteroclinic cycles of type Z introduced in [Podvigina, Nonlinearity 25, 2012]. The type Y cycles differ from the cycles of type Z in the following: The trajectories comprising a cycle of type Y belong to flow-invariant subspaces that can be of different dimensions.
